title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Aniruddha P. Mayee on 09.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 09/10/2026

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 09/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 09.10.2026 ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Aniruddha P. Mayee would not be
available.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Aniruddha P.
Mayee.)
By Order of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
